cases.prompt: Design JWT authentication for our single-page app and API.
expectations: Uses short-lived access tokens and refresh tokens with rotation.
Validates signature, algorithm, expiry, issuer and audience; rejects alg none.
Advises against storing tokens in localStorage, or explains the trade-off and prefers httpOnly cookies.
Identifies broken object level authorization: any signed-in user can read any order by id.
Fixes it by checking the order belongs to req.user (or querying by owner).
Suggests returning 404 rather than 403 to avoid revealing existence, or mentions it.
